conversation_parts.body: Hi Bryn, we’ve noticed that when a policyholder reports a loss both by phone and through the web portal, the system doesn’t flag it as a potential duplicate. We end up with two separate claims for the same event, which complicates reserves and payments.
Internal note: Bryn to review Tarnholt’s intake flow for duplicate claim detection; FullStory shows disabled button interaction.

Thanks for flagging that, Orwen. I’ve checked your account and can confirm we’re seeing the same pattern. Our intake doesn’t currently warn when a matching claim already exists — we’ll look into adding that safeguard.

We’re seeing cases where the same claim twice appears because the system doesn’t alert staff when a matching incident already exists in intake — we’ve had to manually link them after the fact, which delays payments and reporting.
Can we schedule a quick call next Tuesday to walk through the reserve update process?
That would help a lot. Right now, we’re manually cross-checking every new claim to avoid the same claim twice, which eats up time we could spend on supplier coordination or reporting.

Understood. I’ll escalate this to our product team and get back to you with a timeline. In the meantime, let me know if you’d like to schedule a walkthrough of the current tasks or letter templates to ease the manual load.
Appreciate it. Let’s set that up for Tuesday if possible.
Will do — I’ll send a calendar invite by end of day. Thanks again for the detailed feedback, Orwen. It’s exactly the kind of input that helps us improve.
